name: Dependency Security Audit (Cargo)
description: Scan a Rust project’s Cargo.lock for crates with known security advisories using cargo-audit on a schedule, the Rust counterpart to the npm and pip audit templates.

parameters.label: Cargo.lock path
parameters.help: Absolute path to the Cargo.lock file to audit. The cargo-audit tool must be installed, for example with cargo install cargo-audit. It exits non-zero when it finds a vulnerable crate, so the run shows as failed exactly when there is something to fix.
